name: Jared Carter
role: Missionary and Kirtland temple committee member
dateNote: Section 79 sent him east on 12 March 1832, and section 94 named him to the building committee in August 1833.
importance: Jared Carter was baptized at Colesville in February 1831 and moved with that branch to Ohio. Section 79 sends him again to preach in the eastern states. Section 94 names him to the Kirtland building committee with Hyrum Smith and Reynolds Cahoon, and section 102 lists him on the high council. In Missouri in 1838 he was briefly a leader among the Danites; he later moved to Nauvoo.
connections: His brothers John S. Carter and Simeon D. Carter also served as elders. He worked with Hyrum Smith and Reynolds Cahoon on the temple.

sources.title: Jared Carter, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates and roles checked on JSP; death 6 July 1849 read from a cut fragment. The batch note calls him a convert from Amherst; JSP says he was baptized at Colesville and moved with that branch to Thompson. Brothers John S. and Simeon D. Carter are named on the JSP John S. Carter page.
